scenes.text: Add or subtract numerators only after making denominators equal. Simplify the final fraction.
Calculate 5/8 minus 3/8. The answer is 1/4. Work on the numerators, then simplify: 1/4.
A measuring tape in the class garden starts at 5/8 metre and gains 2/8 metre. What length results? Pause the video and think.
A measuring tape in the class garden starts at 5/8 metre and gains 2/8 metre. What length results? The answer is 7/8. Work on the numerators, then simplify: 7/8.
